attempts.response:
```sql
SELECT
  t1.District,
  t2."Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" - t1."Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS percentage_point_change
FROM (
  SELECT
    District,
    "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)"
  FROM district_health_factsheet
  WHERE State = 'Bihar' AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'
) AS t1
JOIN (
  SELECT
    District,
    "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)"
  FROM district_health_factsheet
  WHERE State = 'Bihar' AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5'
) AS t2
ON t1.District = t2.District;
```
